_note: Single source of truth for plans, prices and limits. Prices are in whole units (EGP pounds, US dollars). Pro is PREPAID: one payment buys 3, 6 or 12 months, nothing renews automatically.

renewal.stacking: Buying again while Pro is active adds the new months after the current end date.

launchOffer._note: Optional launch offer (PRICING.md). When enabled, the first `firstBuyers` paid Pro orders can buy `months` months for the price of `priceOfMonths` months.

payments._note: chargeUsd: whether the Paymob account can charge in USD. While false, USD prices are charged as the EGP equivalent at that day's rate.
